source_findings.meaning: Mixed preserves differing check judgments within one source object; a local refutation does not refute every check or a whole figure. Unresolved means object-level source agreement is not established, not that every check is unfinished. Objects including declared variants or legacy checks without source interpretations can have decisive check judgments; read check_findings for each proposition's result.
